# Remote Data Analyst Cover Letter for a Berlin Product Team

## Tailored Cover Letter Draft
Subject: Application for Data Analyst, Remote — Berlin

Dear Hiring Manager,

I’m excited to apply for the Data Analyst role on your product analytics team. With 4 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Tableau, and basic Python, I’ve built a strong foundation in turning complex retail data into clear insights, dashboards, and practical recommendations that support better decisions across teams.

In my current role at a large corporation, I’ve learned how to work effectively with diverse stakeholders, translate business questions into analysis, and deliver reporting that is both accurate and easy to act on. A major part of my work has been dashboarding in Tableau, where I’ve focused on building views that help teams quickly understand performance, spot trends, and prioritize action. I’m especially comfortable partnering with non-technical stakeholders and making data feel usable, not just available.

I’m now looking to bring that experience to a smaller product company where I can have greater ownership and closer impact on product decisions. The opportunity to work remotely from Berlin, collaborate across functions, and contribute in a flexible, fast-moving environment is exactly what I’m seeking. I’m also comfortable aligning with a salary range of €58,000–€68,000, depending on the overall scope and benefits.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my analytics background, communication style, and dashboarding experience can support your product team. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

## Quick Customization Points
- Replace `[Your Name]` with the candidate’s full name.
- If needed, add one concrete achievement, such as revenue impact, reporting scale, or dashboard adoption.
- If the company is product-led, you can strengthen the product angle by mentioning experimentation, funnel analysis, or KPI tracking.

## Sources
- Berlin work context and salary benchmarking: https://www.gehalt.de/beruf/data-analyst
- Product analytics role expectations: https://www.productplan.com/glossary/product-analytics/
- Remote work hiring context: https://buffer.com/state-of-remote-work
